column3: Close to the Greek; “the holy, sure things of David” is rendered “the sure mercies of David.”
Close to the Greek; NKJV adds “Psalm.”
NKJV has “when the Jews went out of the synagogue, the Gentiles begged,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “as they went out, they begged.”
NKJV has “the word of God,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “the word of the Lord.”
NKJV includes “contradicting and,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text has “blaspheming.” “Jealousy” is rendered “envy.”
NKJV has “the devout and prominent women,” following the Textus Receptus wording.
